title: cistanthe litoralis
intro: Cistanthe litoralis, commonly known as Purple Cress or Pink Stem Cress, is a flowering plant species native to the coastal regions of South America. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, acting as an antioxidant, and aiding in the treatment of respiratory issues such as bronchitis. The therapeutic actions of Cistanthe litoralis are attributed to its ability to relax muscles, reduce fever, and exhibit antibacterial properties. Bioactive constituents present in the plant include flavonoids, glycosides, and alkaloids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
